summary_en: Annual dividend raised to ¥170/share (from ¥140) for FY3/26 period. Ordinary component ¥120 (from ¥90), commemorative component ¥50 unchanged. Payout ratio target maintained at 30%+ under mid-term plan (FY3/24–3/26). Full-year net profit forecast upgraded to ¥1.1B (+37.5%). Subject to shareholder approval at December 2026 AGM.
title_en: Notification of revision to full-year earnings and dividend forecast for FY3/26 (dividend increase)
translation_en_brief:
Kawagishi Bridge Works revised its full-year earnings and dividend forecast for the fiscal year ending September 2026 (FY3/26). Net profit guidance was raised from ¥800M to ¥1.1B (+37.5%), driven by completion of large-scale, high-margin projects and design-change orders, partially offset by higher material and labor costs.

The company increased its annual dividend per share from ¥140 to ¥170, comprising an ordinary dividend of ¥120 (raised from ¥90) and a commemorative dividend of ¥50 (unchanged). This 21.4% increase reflects the upgraded earnings and aligns with the company's stated policy to maintain and improve stable dividends while targeting a payout ratio of 30% or higher during the current mid-term management plan period (FY3/24–FY3/26).

The dividend revision is subject to approval at the ordinary general shareholders' meeting scheduled for December 2026.
